preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 100)
preconditions.description: The first line of input is T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100), the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() and (line.split()[0].isdigit() and all(x.isdigit() for x in line.split()[1:])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100), followed by n lines describing SWAG Traits. Each SWAG Trait line starts with ki (1 ≤ ki ≤ 100), followed by ki positive integers (≤ 1000).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == ki + 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and (ki := int(line.split()[0])) > 0)
preconditions.description: Each SWAG Trait line has exactly ki + 1 integers (ki followed by ki elements).

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is two space-separated integers representing RK's and RG's Swag Levels.

postconditions.expression: all(all(x.isdigit() for x in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output integer is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all((rk_sum, rg_sum) == optimal_swag_levels(test_case) for test_case, (rk_sum, rg_sum) in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integers are the optimal Swag Levels of RK and RG when both play optimally. RK always picks from the front of any non-empty SWAG Trait, and RG picks from the back of any non-empty SWAG Trait. The sum of all elements in the SWAG Traits equals rk_sum + rg_sum.
